about.title: What is Neuromundi?
about.body1: Neuromundi is the world's first platform specialized in neurodevelopment, neurodivergence and neurological conditions: community and marketplace in one place. We connect families and patients with specialists, inclusive businesses and schools, plus a directory of vetted professionals, a store of products and resources, and an academy with courses.
about.body2: Families and patients sign up and use the platform at no cost. Neuromundi's purpose is to make quality support easy to find — with real reviews, reliable information and safe tools, all in one place.

neurodesarrollo.name: Neurodevelopment
neurodesarrollo.desc: How the brain and abilities develop from early childhood (language, motor skills, learning), and support when that development follows a different pace.

neurodivergencias.name: Neurodivergence
neurodivergencias.desc: Ways of brain functioning that differ from the typical, such as autism or ADHD; they are not illnesses, but different ways of perceiving and learning.

afecciones.name: Neurological conditions
afecciones.desc: Medical conditions of the nervous system, such as epilepsy, cerebral palsy or sclerosis, that require clinical care.

sections.explainIntro: Neuromundi organizes support into three broad areas. On a provider's profile, these labels indicate the areas they serve or offer.
sections.pickLabel: Which area does it belong to?
sections.pickHint: Tick one or more so the people looking for exactly that can find it. If you tick none, it will show up in every search.

counters.title: Neuromundi by the numbers
counters.catTitle: Catalog of specialties, products and services
counters.source: Estimates: GBD 2021 (The Lancet Neurology) for neurological and neurodevelopmental conditions; neurodivergence ~15–20% of the population.

ally.title: A community grounded in science
ally.text: We work hand in hand with the Observatorio Internacional de Neuroeducación y Neurodiversidad (Observatorio Internacional de Neuroeducación y Neurodiversidad), our academic ally. This alliance commits us to keeping what you find here —resources, guides and criteria— grounded in evidence and in a neuroaffirming approach, far from fads and pseudoscience.
ally.note: An academic alliance for guidance and content; it does not imply clinical endorsement of each listed provider.
ally.logoAlt: Observatorio Internacional de Neuroeducación y Neurodiversidad
